summary: Immuron Ltd furnished a Form 6-K attaching its notice of 2026 Annual General Meeting and proxy form, published to the ASX on October 16, 2026 (the US equivalent of an annual meeting proxy circular). The meeting is set for November 18, 2026 in Carlton South, Victoria, with ordinary business covering FY2026 financial statements and auditor reports, an advisory adoption of the remuneration report, re-election of Non-Executive Director Dr Jeannette Anne Joughin, and a special resolution seeking approval of increased placement capacity under ASX Listing Rule 7.1A. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or close date is stated. Watch only the placement-capacity vote as a potential dilution overhang signal.
